candidates.change_summary: Return a hardcoded address instead of reading from calldata, so owner() returns a different value that still does not revert.
Return address(0) instead of the calldata-derived owner, so owner() returns a different value that still does not revert.
Return msg.sender instead of calldata-derived owner, allowing the call to complete without revert but with a different return value.
Return ERC20(0x14) directly without using _getArgAddress, changing the returned collateral address.
Return address from a different calldata offset (0x28) instead of 0x14.
Change the return type from ERC20 to address by removing the ERC20 cast around _getArgAddress
Remove the address(es) around collateral_ and debt_ so the clone data encodes different (smaller) types, changing the address generated by create.
Remove the restriction that only the lender can approve a transfer, allowing anyone to set approvals.
Always set approval to msg.sender instead of the provided to_ address.
Delete the approval assignment, making the function a no-op that still checks the lender restriction.
Move the lender restriction check after the approval assignment, allowing non-lenders to set an approval before the check reverts.
